overall_assessment: The repository standards inheritance and companion change governance codified across integration/passports/repository-standards-inheritance.json, migration/companion-repositories/repository-standards.json, docs/repository-standards-alignment.md, migration/estate/repositories.json, scripts/check_integration_passports.py, scripts/check_integration_drift.py, scripts/check_companion_change_packets.py, and tests/test_foundation_toolchain_governance.py establish rigorous, fail-closed policy alignment for Searchright. The standards inheritance passport (integration/passports/repository-standards-inheritance.json, schema org.searchright.integration-passport.v1) defines authoritative governance consumption from upstream edithatogo/repository-standards while barring unauthorized local divergence. The prepared companion change packet (migration/companion-repositories/repository-standards.json, schema org.searchright.companion-change-packet.v1) enforces remote_mutation_permitted: false, preventing unauthorized upstream writes during local CI/CD passes. Drift and passport validation scripts run network-free, ensuring local repository contracts match inheritance definitions. Crucially, upstream registration in edithatogo/repository-standards and external estate conformance are preserved as open operational gates rather than prematurely claimed, maintaining uncompromised evidence boundaries. All unit tests in tests/test_foundation_toolchain_governance.py pass 100% network-free.
verified_invariants: Standards inheritance passport: integration/passports/repository-standards-inheritance.json locks edithatogo/repository-standards schema and policies
Fail-closed companion change packet: migration/companion-repositories/repository-standards.json enforces remote_mutation_permitted: false
Preserved open operational gate: upstream registration and estate conformance are strictly preserved as open blockers rather than claimed complete
Alignment documentation: docs/repository-standards-alignment.md documents repository standards taxonomy and governance compliance
Integration drift checks: scripts/check_integration_passports.py and check_companion_change_packets.py verify passport contracts network-free
Deterministic test verification: test_repository_standards_inheritance_and_companion_packet passes network-free in tests/test_foundation_toolchain_governance.py

findings.description: The inheritance passport, companion packet, and alignment documentation are fully established; live registration in edithatogo/repository-standards and external estate conformance remain an open operational gate.
findings.recommendation: Preserve open blocker "Register Searchright in edithatogo/repository-standards and execute estate conformance at an approved upstream revision" until remote registration occurs under explicit authorization.

findings.description: Companion change packet migration/companion-repositories/repository-standards.json explicitly sets remote_mutation_permitted: false, preventing unauthorized upstream writes during local CI/CD passes.
findings.recommendation: Maintain strict dry-run and read-only constraints for companion change packets.

assertions_evaluated.notes: Policy inheritance passport, fail-closed companion change packet with remote_mutation_permitted: false, alignment docs, and integration checks verified; upstream estate conformance preserved as an open operational gate.

limitations: Policy inheritance passport, companion packet, and local conformance contracts verified; live registration in edithatogo/repository-standards and external estate scanner execution remain open operational gates.
